note: data/biblio.json is emitted from the authoritative openpatala DB (PG18 box). This box runs PG15 with a mirror DB (1,034 works after the Muktabodha seed), so a local re-emit is NOT the authority. --check verifies the committed file against this digest instead of failing on the mirror gap.
